## What changed

- **Support for Ruby (`.rb`) and Rake (`.rake`) files.** Added tree-sitter AST symbol extraction for classes, modules, methods, singleton methods (`def self.method`), constants, and scoped declarations (`A::B`), plus Rake tasks (`task`, `multitask`, `file`) and `namespace` blocks. Supports Ruby method naming conventions (`valid?`, `save!`, `count=`, `==`, `[]`).
- **Hash-commented code reference scanning.** `# @lat:` comments in `.rb` and `.rake` files are scanned and linked to test specifications and architectural concepts.
- **Syntax highlighting and UI badges.** Ruby and Rake references display the `RB` language badge in markdown views and use safe server-side syntax highlighting.
- **Merged upstream improvements.** Includes compact English Snowball stemmer package, Mermaid multi-line HTML label fix, copy-to-clipboard on code blocks, and portable UI sites and Vercel build targets.

## Upgrading

```
mise use -g npm:@plebeiantech/lat.md@latest
```

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
